verdict.rationale: Square publishes a developer llms.txt, confirmed live by an HTTP 200 probe. It is explicitly designed for AI agents, includes agent guidance, and points to a full llms-full.txt corpus; individual docs pages also render as raw markdown by appending `.md`. The /docs.md root returned 404, but per-page .md URLs such as /docs/mcp.md are cited, so this does not undercut the claim. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of an agent consuming the llms.txt/markdown docs, and a working markdown version of the docs root (/docs.md returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Designed to be consumable by both human developers and AI agents
Docs pages also render as raw markdown by appending `.md` to the URL.
